## Linked Issues
<!-- Use keywords like Closes #1, Fixes #2, or simply mention the issue. -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring (internal change with no user-facing impact)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the project's [AI Development Instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md)
- [ ] Build passes locally (`cargo build --all --features gui`)
- [ ] All tests pass (`cargo test --all`)
- [ ] Code is formatted (`cargo fmt`)
- [ ] `clippy` is clean (`cargo clippy`)
- [ ] Added unit/integration tests (if applicable)
- [ ] Updated documentation (README, DEVELOPMENT.md, comments)
